and business card.
Good morning, Ms. Millner. I wasn't expecting to
see you back here so soon. I hope there wasn't a
problem with the business cards we printed for you.
Well, actually, that is why I'm here. I like the design,
but there's a spelling error right here— it's Carson
with an O, not an E. It should be C-A-R-S-O-N.
I'm so sorry about that. We'll reprint the cards for you
at no cost. How soon do you need them?
By tomorrow afternoon. I'm going to Belmont
Gym's grand opening tomorrow night. I'll be working
there as a fitness coach, and I'd like to pass out my
business cards to potential clients.
Laura Millner
